text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Guess everybody's got at least one good point, huh?
Sorry for looking down on ya.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, I'm just kidding!
My bad, got carried away.
I mean, you're seriously amazing!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'll take good care of it.
Thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, don't freak out.
Even I know how to say thank you!
